## Setup

```{r libraries}
library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(tibble)
```

```{r paths}
sample_dirs <- c(
  Y   = "/home/vkorob/Documents/data_scripts/visium/Visium_SJ_3ages/Y",
  M   = "/home/vkorob/Documents/data_scripts/visium/Visium_SJ_3ages/M",
  O_1 = "/home/vkorob/Documents/data_scripts/visium/Visium_SJ_3ages/O_1",
  O_2 = "/home/vkorob/Documents/data_scripts/visium/Visium_SJ_3ages/O_2"
)

age_lookup <- c(Y = "young", M = "middle", O_1 = "old", O_2 = "old")

out_dir <- file.path("output", "01_processing_subset_to_HPC")
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# find the slide subfolders inside each age/replicate directory
slide_df <- imap_dfr(sample_dirs, function(dir_path, group_name) {
  slide_paths <- list.dirs(dir_path, recursive = FALSE, full.names = TRUE)
  tibble(
    group  = group_name,
    slide  = basename(slide_paths),
    path   = slide_paths,
    sample = paste(group_name, basename(slide_paths), sep = "_"),
    age    = age_lookup[[group_name]]
  )
})

spatial_dirs    <- setNames(slide_df$path, slide_df$sample)
age_lookup_full <- setNames(slide_df$age, slide_df$sample)

slide_df
```

## Load each slide and compute QC metrics

```{r load-and-qc}
load_and_qc <- function(sample_dir, sample_name) {

  message("Loading: ", sample_name)
  sp_obj <- Load10X_Spatial(data.dir = sample_dir)
  sp_obj$sample <- sample_name
  sp_obj$age    <- age_lookup_full[[sample_name]]

  # mitochondrial content - adjust pattern if not mouse ("^mt-")
  sp_obj[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(sp_obj, pattern = "^mt-")

  sp_obj
}

seurat_list <- imap(spatial_dirs, load_and_qc)
```

## Visualize QC metrics per sample (before filtering)

```{r qc-plots-before, fig.width=12, fig.height=5}
for (sample_name in names(seurat_list)) {
  sp_obj <- seurat_list[[sample_name]]

  p1 <- VlnPlot(sp_obj, features = "nCount_Spatial", pt.size = 0) + NoLegend()
  p2 <- VlnPlot(sp_obj, features = "nFeature_Spatial", pt.size = 0) + NoLegend()
  p3 <- VlnPlot(sp_obj, features = "percent.mt", pt.size = 0) + NoLegend()

  print((p1 | p2 | p3) + plot_annotation(title = sample_name))
}
```

## QC thresholds (not applied)

Kept for reference but intentionally not run (`eval=FALSE`): spots are only filtered by the manual hippocampus selection below.

```{r qc-filter, eval=FALSE}
min_counts  <- 500
min_features <- 200
max_mt_pct  <- 20

qc_summary <- imap_dfr(seurat_list, function(sp_obj, sample_name) {
  n_before <- ncol(sp_obj)
  tibble(sample = sample_name, n_spots_before = n_before)
})

seurat_list <- imap(seurat_list, function(sp_obj, sample_name) {
  sp_obj <- subset(
    sp_obj,
    subset = nCount_Spatial >= min_counts &
             nFeature_Spatial >= min_features &
             percent.mt <= max_mt_pct
  )
  sp_obj
})

qc_summary <- qc_summary %>%
  left_join(
    imap_dfr(seurat_list, ~ tibble(sample = .y, n_spots_after = ncol(.x))),
    by = "sample"
  ) %>%
  mutate(pct_retained = round(100 * n_spots_after / n_spots_before, 1))

qc_summary
write.csv(qc_summary, file.path(out_dir, "qc_summary.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

## Manual hippocampus selection (via Loupe Browser)

Hippocampus spots were selected manually in Loupe Browser and exported per slide as `HPC_coords_1.csv` (and `HPC_coords_2.csv` when a slide has a second hemisphere) in the slide's folder.

```{r manual-region-selection, warning=FALSE}
subset_to_hippocampus <- function(sample_name, sp_obj, barcode_dir) {

  barcode_file1 <- file.path(barcode_dir, "HPC_coords_1.csv")

  if (!file.exists(barcode_file1)) {
    warning("No barcode file found for ", sample_name, " - skipping region subset")
    return(sp_obj)
  }

  keep_barcodes <- read.csv(barcode_file1, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)[[1]]
  
  # some slides have the 2 hemispheres, add second
  barcode_file2 <- file.path(barcode_dir, "HPC_coords_2.csv")
  if (file.exists(barcode_file2)) {
    keep_barcodes2 = read.csv(barcode_file2, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)[[1]]
    
    keep_barcodes = c(keep_barcodes, keep_barcodes2)
  }
  
  keep_barcodes <- intersect(keep_barcodes, colnames(sp_obj))

  message(sample_name, ": keeping ", length(keep_barcodes), " / ", ncol(sp_obj), " spots (hippocampus)")

  subset(sp_obj, cells = keep_barcodes)
}

for (sample_name in names(seurat_list)) {
  seurat_list[[sample_name]] <- subset_to_hippocampus(
    sample_name,
    seurat_list[[sample_name]],
    spatial_dirs[sample_name]
  )
}
```

## Confirm the crop looks right

```{r qc-plots-region, fig.width=6, fig.height=6}
for (sample_name in names(seurat_list)) {
  sp_obj <- seurat_list[[sample_name]]
  print(SpatialDimPlot(sp_obj, alpha = 0.6) + ggtitle(paste(sample_name, "- hippocampus only")))
}
```

## Save processed objects

```{r save-outputs}
for (sample_name in names(seurat_list)) {
  saveRDS(seurat_list[[sample_name]], file.path(out_dir, paste0(sample_name, "_QC_hippocampus.rds")))
}

final_summary <- imap_dfr(seurat_list, ~ tibble(
  sample = .y,
  age = age_lookup_full[[.y]],
  n_spots_final = ncol(.x)
))

final_summary
write.csv(final_summary, file.path(out_dir, "final_spot_counts.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```
